purpose: Measure the shipped planning pipeline (look if needed, plan, review, at most one re-plan) on a random sample of ordinary Bible verses: acceptance, refusal, flawed-plan and latency rates. No images, no production writes.
authorization: Owner chose option (a) on 2026-10-23, as proposed: about 100 random verses for roughly $0.20-0.30. Recorded as a $0.30 increase to the evaluation allowance ($16.50 to $16.80), all of it capped to this run.

sampling.frame: All 31,102 verses of the imported WEB Bible, mapped to the active generation-1 moment that contains each (what a reader's request for that verse prepares).
sampling.method: Draw verse positions uniformly with a mulberry32 generator seeded 20261023, skipping a verse whose moment was already drawn, until 100 distinct moments. Moments are therefore weighted by length, as readers meet them.

execution: This repository's prepareMoment at the pipeline commit runs locally over a fresh in-memory store per sample, seeded from read-only production records for that sample (moment, section, cast entries and the section look if one is stored). No plan is seeded. A missing or stale look is prepared in memory, as a reader's cold request would. Production is read once per sample before the run; nothing is written there. Production adapter, routing and default sampling.
retryPolicy: Each sample is one ordinary prepareMoment. No other rerun, response edit or replacement sample. A provider error, missing usage, uncertain outcome, unexpected request or exhausted reserve stops the run; untaken samples are reported as missing and the results describe the samples taken.

rubric.scoredText: Scene fields and present ids, with the verse, its same-section neighbors, the section cast (id, name, hasForm) and the brief's depiction rules. Outcome, rounds, review problems, grounding audit and which-plan-it-is are withheld.

flags.U: Unselected described figure: a person, group or animal with a section cast entry is described in a scene field while its id is not in present. Places and objects do not count.
flags.X: Outside the moment: a selected or described person, group, animal or selected place that does not belong to the depicted instant. This covers a narrator, speaker or listener shown inside the story, vision or report they only tell or watch, and a figure or place from an earlier or later event that this verse does not place there. Depicting the speaker of a teaching, prayer, letter or prophecy delivering it is not X. Scenery and effects do not count.
flags.I: Not one instant: a character has two incompatible poses or places, or successive actions are presented as happening together.
flags.F: Bodily no-form subject: a cast entry with hasForm false, or God the Father or the Holy Spirit as the depiction rules describe them, is given a human body, face, hair, clothing, silhouette or figure, or is described as seated, sitting, enthroned or occupying a seat (including its effects called seated).
flags.R: Another depiction rule is broken: lingering gore, sexual content, ethnic or religious caricature, comic visionary creatures, or modern objects.
flags.M: Mis-depicts the verse: the scene shows a different event or contradicts what the verse states. For verses without a concrete event (law, poetry, teaching, lists, genealogies), any reasonable illustration of the verse's content or setting is fine; flag only a clear contradiction or a different event.
flags.N: Note, not a blocker: a prohibited figure is named only to deny it.

rubric.pass: The sample stored a plan with none of U, X, I, F, R or M.
rubric.withoutReview: Each sample's first plan reply is also scored. It approximates the same planner without the review: stored if it passed the evidence checks, otherwise refused. This paired estimate costs no extra calls.
rubric.scorers: Two fresh, independent subagents with identical instructions, each scoring every unique reply blind. The operator does not score; disagreements are resolved by the operator with a recorded rationale before unblinding.

reported: Acceptance (stored and clean), flawed-stored, refusal and false-refusal rates with 95% Wilson intervals, for the pipeline and the without-review estimate; the same by book group (Law, History, Wisdom, Prophets, Gospels and Acts, Letters and Revelation); re-plan and look-preparation rates; per-sample preparation time (including any look) median and p90; cost per sample. No release threshold is pre-set here: acceptable rates are an owner decision.
